1. (Currently Amended) A method, comprising: transmitting a sequence of __infrared__ light pulses having a first speed __from a first vehicle to establish communication__; receiving a second sequence of __infrared__ light pulses from a __second__ vehicle __via an infrared sensor__; and transmitting a message as a sequence of __infrared__ light pulses having a second speed based on the second sequence of __infrared__ light pulses received from the __second__ vehicle, wherein the first speed is different from the second speed __and wherein the message includes vehicle safety information__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein a computing device determines the second speed based on the second sequence of __infrared__ light pulses received from the __second__ vehicle that is slower than the first speed.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 2, wherein the computing device determines when the __second__ vehicle is no longer in proximity and transmits a sequence of __infrared__ light pulses having a third speed, wherein the third speed is faster than the second speed.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3, wherein the computing device receives a third sequence of __infrared__ light pulses from a third vehicle and transmits the message as a sequence of __infrared__ light pulses having a __fourth__ speed based on the third sequence of __infrared__ light pulses received from the __third__ vehicle, wherein the __fourth__ speed is different from the second speed.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the __infrared__ light pulses are modulated IR radiation.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the message includes information regarding vehicle position, motion, size, safety events, path history and vehicle status, encoded into __infrared__ light pulses as binary bits, wherein the encoding is independent of message transmission speed.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6, wherein the message is also transmitted via a wireless vehicle-to-vehicle network.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the sequences of __infrared__ light pulses are received via an IR video sensor.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the sequences of __infrared__ light pulses are received from two or more vehicles.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, further comprising: emitting the message as a sequence of __infrared__ light pulses having a fourth speed based on the sequences of __infrared__ light pulses, wherein the fourth speed is set equal to the slowest of the sequences of __infrared__ light pulses.

11.
